cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Yes, Under My Physics
cards.instruction: Agree completely, then redefine each term using rules that make your preferred outcome inevitable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Absolutely, I'll move forward for the photo. Forward means facing the camera; I'm perfectly placed in this shade. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I need you two feet closer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Certainly. Feet are units of zoom. Increase yours by two.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. A full portrait means all the important parts. You've captured me completely.

mechanism: A agrees to photographic directions and makes a small accommodation while redefining spatial and framing terms so A stays in the preferred shade.
confusable: Unlike openly refusing the photographer, A says yes and declares rules that make compliance mean remaining where A wants.
comparison: Photography framing and shade differ from box moving without personal exertion.
seedUse: D167-a forward, feet as zoom and face-only portrait; S02-a offers minimal bodily cooperation while controlling definitions.
